title: Cartwise Shopper Batches Five-Star Offer Supplement
content:
Five-star customer ratings recorded against a Cartwise Shopper Batches batch on the shopper's Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts record add a five-star offer supplement to the guaranteed offer figure in a shown-pay claim:

| Five-star ratings recorded against the batch | Supplement |
|---|---|
| Two or more | 1.00 |
| Exactly one | 0.50 |
| None | Nothing |

The supplement is added to the guaranteed offer figure after that figure has been multiplied by any share applying to it; the supplement itself is never multiplied. The figure so formed is the guaranteed amount the claim is worked from.

## Points of judgement

- Only ratings of five stars count, and only those recorded against this batch.
- Hypothetical: a Double Delivery Batch whose two orders were each rated five stars receives 1.00; one five-star rating and one four-star rating gives 0.50.
- Hypothetical: a guaranteed offer figure of 18.00 multiplied by a share of 0.97 is 17.46; with two five-star ratings the guaranteed amount is 17.46 plus 1.00, that is 18.46.
